attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Maine military retirement income exclusion. Provides 100% exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments. Extended to Space Force, USPHS, and NOAA in 2026. Honors MSRRA (spouse income exempt if different domicile) and SCRA (active duty pay exempt if different state of residence). Per 36 MRS § 5122 (2025).

Calculates Maine state income tax per Form 1040ME. Maine uses progressive tax rates (5.8%, 6.75%, 7.15%) with standard deductions and personal exemptions. Starting with federal AGI, subtracts pension/SS income (Maine exempts SS and allows pension deduction up to $48,216), applies standard deduction and personal exemptions, then calculates tax using progressive brackets.

initial_action.action_postfix: "MAINE FORM 1040ME - State Income Tax Calculation" job.audit_trail swap addto 0 local@ num_people > result.agi /result.me_agi xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate ME tax for Single filer; Apply ME deductions and calculate tax using Single brackets
action_details.action_postfix: " Starting Federal AGI: $" result.agi cvs strconcat " (Form 1040 Line 11)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto job.taxpayers arraysize job.dependents arraysize + local@ num_people > 0 local@ me_pension_subtraction > 0 local@ me_ss_subtraction > { dup type income_type > income_type "pension" streq income_type "ira_distribution" streq or if dup gross_amount me_pension_subtraction f+ local@ me_pension_subtraction > endif income_type "social_security" streq if dup gross_amount me_ss_subtraction f+ local@ me_ss_subtraction > endif } job.incomes forall me_ss_subtraction 0 f> if " Subtract Social Security (exempt): -$" me_ss_subtraction cvs strconcat " (ME fully exempts SS benefits)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.me_agi me_ss_subtraction f- /result.me_agi xdef endif me_pension_subtraction 0 f> if me_pension_subtraction me_pension_deduction_max fmin /result.me_pension_subtraction xdef " Subtract Pension Income: -$" result.me_pension_subtraction cvs strconcat " (ME allows up to $" strconcat me_pension_deduction_max cvs strconcat " max)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.me_agi result.me_pension_subtraction f- /result.me_agi xdef endif " Maine AGI: $" result.me_agi cvs strconcat " (Form 1040ME Line 11)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto me_std_deduction_single /result.me_standard_deduction xdef " Standard Deduction: -$" result.me_standard_deduction cvs strconcat " (Single)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto num_people me_personal_exemption f* /result.me_exemption_total xdef " Personal Exemptions: " num_people cvs strconcat " × $" strconcat me_personal_exemption cvs strconcat " = -$" strconcat result.me_exemption_total cvs strconcat strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.me_agi result.me_standard_deduction f- result.me_exemption_total f- 0 fmax /result.me_taxable_income xdef " Maine Taxable Income: $" result.me_taxable_income cvs strconcat " (AGI - Deductions - Exemptions)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.me_taxable_income me_bracket_1_single f<= if result.me_taxable_income me_tax_rate_1 f* /result.me_tax xdef " Tax (5.8% rate): $" result.me_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto else result.me_taxable_income me_bracket_2_single f<= if me_bracket_1_single me_tax_rate_1 f* result.me_taxable_income me_bracket_1_single f- me_tax_rate_2 f* f+ /result.me_tax xdef " Tax (brackets 5.8% + 6.75%): $" result.me_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto else me_bracket_1_single me_tax_rate_1 f* me_bracket_2_single me_bracket_1_single f- me_tax_rate_2 f* f+ result.me_taxable_income me_bracket_2_single f- me_tax_rate_3 f* f+ /result.me_tax xdef " Tax (all brackets 5.8% + 6.75% + 7.15%): $" result.me_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto endif endif
